dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: Hmph, what a shame. I thought that this was my big chance, but it was all over before I could even pull the sword out.

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: If only I had, then I would have been able to defeat Stormterror. I mean, it's a sword of legend, and so I must be...

dialogues.speaker: Arthur
dialogues.text: What? Me, scared? I was never scared, I just hadn't pulled the sword out yet!
